jobs.title: Senior Associate | Cyber, Risk, and Regulatory Advisory

bullets.lead: Lead 30+ Walkthroughs to Complete Testing & Remediation of 200+ IT General and Application SOX Controls
bullets.body: Developed and monitored project plan in AuditBoard & managed communications with External Audit team
Built & executed comprehensive project roadmap to design **100+ controls** and document **13+ processes** to evaluate current state compliance in preparation for External Audit

Automated Risk Assessment survey using Power Query to automate data extraction and transformation; resulting **140+ engineering hours** saved annually & enhanced data-driven decision making and risk visibility for **70+** service teams

bullets.lead: Built Scalable Compliance Framework for New Regulation
bullets.body: Designed a comprehensive framework for compliance with the EU Digital Services Act (DSA), including policies, procedures, and controls, positioning the firm as a leader in the regulatory space, resulting in a **$1.6M** contract extension

bullets.lead: Common Controls Framework for Technology Company
bullets.body: Leading pilot project to map **900+** existing company Operational Security Standards against external frameworks; designing process to ensure ongoing compliance with emerging regulatory requirements and create foundation for long-term audit readiness

bullets.lead: Developed 8+ Tools & Dashboards for Continuous Monitoring
bullets.body: Enabled tracking of critical tasks and KPIs to facilitate real-time risk identification and remediation across IT and business operations
Automated status report generation and distribution for **35+** geographic regions using Power Platform, reducing manual effort by **420 hours per quarter**

bullets.lead: Leveraged Generative AI to Reduce Manual Effort by 110 Hours
bullets.body: Optimized prompts to redraft **260+** risk statements and **180+** control objectives, enabling team to meet external audit deadlines
Developed & conducted training program to educate employees across Legal, Privacy, and Engineering functions on their role in compliance with new regulation

Monitored project budget and strategically reallocated & prioritized resources to enable project to stay on track and within budget; received early promotion in July 2023 as a result of contract extension of **$1.2M** secured
Defined scope, pricing, and built slideware for several Request for Proposals (RFPs); resulted in successful outcomes for **5** projects valued at a total combined revenue of **$5.8M**
Assessed financial and operational controls, ensuring key SOX controls were effective; received internship return offer
